name: guardian_pricing
description: Price per million tokens for each model, used by the cost ledger. A model with no row is priced at USD 0 and a warning is shown. A row matches a dated or tagged model name by its leading part (gpt-5-mini covers gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07). gpt-5-mini is the Azure Global Standard list price; cohere-command-a is the Cohere list price (Azure Foundry, Global); command-r:35b is an estimate of a self-hosted GPU (one NVIDIA L4 at about USD 0.71 per hour, fully busy), not a vendor price: replace it with your own internal rate. To add or change a model, edit this list's JSON and install the pack again.
